25: def profilePairHomeomorph (P Q : SiteProfile) (hpos : 0<profileAffinityLimit P Q) :
26:     (TowerHilbert Q×TowerHilbert Q) ≃ₜ (TowerHilbert P×TowerHilbert P) :=
27:   (profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos).toHomeomorph.prodCongr (profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos).toHomeomorph
28: 
29: def profileTomitaGraph (P Q : SiteProfile) (hpos : 0<profileAffinityLimit P Q) :
30:     Set (TowerHilbert P×TowerHilbert P) :=
31:   {p | ∃ A : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P,
32:     A∈theFactorObject P ∧
33:       p=(A (globalProfileVector P Q hpos),(star A) (globalProfileVector P Q hpos))}
34: 
35: theorem profile_tomita_graph_image (P Q : SiteProfile) (hpos : 0<profileAffinityLimit P Q) :
36:     profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos '' tomitaGraph Q=profileTomitaGraph P Q hpos := by
37:   ext p
38:   constructor
39:   · rintro ⟨q,⟨A,hA,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
40:     refine ⟨profileFactorConjugation P Q hpos A,(profile_factor_conjugation_iff P Q hpos A).mp hA,?_⟩
41:     change (profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos (A (hOmega Q)),
42:       profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos ((star A) (hOmega Q)))=_
43:     rw [←map_star (profileFactorConjugation P Q hpos) A]
44:     simp only [profile_factor_conjugation_vector]
45:   · rintro ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩
46:     refine ⟨((profileFactorConjugation P Q hpos).symm A (hOmega Q),
47:       (star ((profileFactorConjugation P Q hpos).symm A)) (hOmega Q)),
48:       ⟨(profileFactorConjugation P Q hpos).symm A,profile_factor_inverse_mem P Q hpos A hA,rfl⟩,?_⟩
49:     change (profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos ((profileFactorConjugation P Q hpos).symm A (hOmega Q)),
50:       profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos ((star ((profileFactorConjugation P Q hpos).symm A)) (hOmega Q)))=_
51:     rw [←profile_factor_conjugation_vector,←profile_factor_conjugation_vector]
52:     simp only [map_star,StarAlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
53: 
54: theorem profile_tomita_closed_graph_image (P Q : SiteProfile) (hpos : 0<profileAffinityLimit P Q) :
55:     profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos '' closure (tomitaGraph Q)=closure (profileTomitaGraph P Q hpos) := by
56:   rw [(profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos).image_closure,profile_tomita_graph_image]
57: 
58: theorem profile_tomita_closed_graph_iff (P Q : SiteProfile) (hpos : 0<profileAffinityLimit P Q)
59:     (x y : TowerHilbert P) :
60:     (x,y)∈closure (profileTomitaGraph P Q hpos) ↔
61:       ((profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos).symm x,(profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos).symm y)∈closure (tomitaGraph Q) := by
62:   rw [←profile_tomita_closed_graph_image]
63:   change (x,y)∈profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos '' closure (tomitaGraph Q) ↔
64:     (profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos).symm (x,y)∈closure (tomitaGraph Q)
65:   constructor
66:   · rintro ⟨p,hp,hp'⟩
67:     rw [←hp',(profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos).symm_apply_apply]
68:     exact hp
69:   · intro hp
70:     exact ⟨(profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos).symm (x,y),hp,
71:       (profilePairHomeomorph P Q hpos).apply_symm_apply (x,y)⟩

89:     (x : profileTomitaDomain P Q hpos) :
90:     ((x : TowerHilbert P),profileTomita P Q hpos x)∈closure (profileTomitaGraph P Q hpos) := by

101:   · rintro ⟨y,hxy⟩

106:     (x y z : TowerHilbert P)
107:     (hy : (x,y)∈closure (profileTomitaGraph P Q hpos))
108:     (hz : (x,z)∈closure (profileTomitaGraph P Q hpos)) : y=z := by
109:   apply (profileGNSUnitary P Q hpos).symm.injective
110:   exact tomita_graph_closure_single_valued _ _ _
111:     ((profile_tomita_closed_graph_iff P Q hpos x y).mp hy)
112:     ((profile_tomita_closed_graph_iff P Q hpos x z).mp hz)

114: theorem profile_tomita_closed_graph_eq (P Q : SiteProfile) (hpos : 0<profileAffinityLimit P Q) :
115:     range (fun x : profileTomitaDomain P Q hpos =>
116:       ((x : TowerHilbert P),profileTomita P Q hpos x))=closure (profileTomitaGraph P Q hpos) := by
117:   ext p
118:   constructor
119:   · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
120:     exact profile_tomita_graph P Q hpos x
121:   · intro hp

123:       ⟨p.1,(profile_tomita_domain_iff P Q hpos p.1).mpr ⟨p.2,hp⟩⟩
124:     refine ⟨x,Prod.ext rfl ?_⟩
125:     exact profile_tomita_graph_single_valued P Q hpos p.1 _ p.2
126:       (profile_tomita_graph P Q hpos x) hp

129:     IsClosed (range (fun x : profileTomitaDomain P Q hpos =>
130:       ((x : TowerHilbert P),profileTomita P Q hpos x))) := by

146:     (A : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) (hA : A∈theFactorObject P) :
